en: The image is a black-and-white photograph of a clean and orderly dining hall or café interior. The space is filled with square tables, each covered with a tablecloth and accompanied by simple wooden or metal chairs. The room features several large, ribbed columns and modernist ceiling lighting. Large windows with patterned curtains let in natural light and provide a view of leafy trees outside. A single vase with a flower is present on each table, indicating attention to decor. The edges of the image have a scalloped border, typical for vintage postcards.
